One worthy mention though, this ship is balanced throughout, making it one of the best pirating ship ever for now.

Both ships were argued in and out in terms of their strengths and weaknesses in various forums. These are a few conclusions that I've made through these discussions. Of course there're many other scenarios used as well as bonuses but that would probably be too much to ride. Best is that one experience these ships in fights to feel it themselves. But one thing can be certain: They don't ***** in fact that are pretty good ships for a 2300 NC box.

For HSFCV, even the Royal Sovereign, the ship with 200 crew plus WMB could not match its melee defense value. This would mean, Faisal box is probably selling 2 end-game ships at the moment considering even 2nd Age ships aren't that capable to match their strength yet, though that will probably change with the introduction of their NC version.

Lets talk about Modified Large Atakebune first. I wrote a bit of my reviews in DB earlier, only to be sunk by wave after wave of reselling bickers, involving several innocents. But lets talk about this ship. The biggest advantage one can find in this ship at first glance is its crew. It has 330 sailors non-improved, a good 165 attack base value without any other factors coming into the formula. Using any melee attack formula you can find, and applying 200 attack base equipment (tempered equipment obviously), HASC, 70 battle level, 100 sailor ability, R20 swordplay and 0 fatigue, multiplied by 4 oxford melee attack skills and pre-amptive attack it is not hard to realize that this ship boast a close to 750, if not 800 attack in first hit. Even for a 500 melee defense WMB series this could mean close to 30-40 sailors wiped in 1 round, depending on actions taken. And if that's not all, imagine an Obstruction or Restriction active aide, with Corvus equipped. Particularly Obstruction, when the few methods to counter an Atakebune's overpowered melee attack is by the use of White Smoke Bombs/Loud Bombs, Smoke with better effect. This ship in its own can deal significant sailor damage, as well as disrupting teamplay of your opponents as they need to consistently use surgery skill allowing for slack in repairs.

One question that's always asked when it comes to this ship is the fact that it only has 1 studding sail and relatively low speed. A few videos on Youtube suggests that this ship is so slow it cannot match other galley ships like FLR for instance. This is a weakness to Atakebune, but not so much an issue in huge fights like BC or ESF. While Atakebune loses out in top speed, it is unbelievably faster than most ships (arguably even turtle ships) when it comes to acceleration. A few theories surround this, such as its already high base armour (33 is very impressive for a galley class), further improvable to 50 if a few mods are great successes (8/8) as well as a belief that ships with lesser studding sails provide better acceleration. I'd believe another theory though, that each ship has its innate acceleration, and Atakebune is given a higher acceleration value in compensation of its low speed. That is why Atakebune is strategically powerful in being deployed close by to opponents, or in a crowded fight where ships naturally don't reach maximum sail speed. It also boasts 1378 durability at max improved state with official panel, making it relatively hard to get sunk in 1 shot. Besides, Modified Large Atakebune also allows Direct Hit Prevention to be modded as optional skill, a skill extremely useful for galley class as it negates all critical hits from bow.

So how do you counter this ship? It sounded like its invincible, but actually its not. The most obvious counter, like all melee ships do, is the use of turtle ship. A turtle ship's hidden ability to evade melee battle basically cuts this ship down to nothing but a weaker armoured cannon ship. Secondly, considering that gaining grounds on melee with the use of items can be countered by Obstruction, the best way is to either use a ship with enough crew that allow for easy retreat (guess what, Attack Prevention Net and 200 sailor ship) such as AFCV will still shine. As to troll this ship, even though a WMB series ship like super frigate series have issues of crew in melee against this monster, another smart way is to put up Heavy Bombing, using a mix of 1 normal shot with your primary cannons. Cutting this ship's advantage in acceleration while keeping tab on your speed advantage could mean both survival as well as seeking good chance to sink this ship from the stern.

Another way to counter this ship, is the use of High Speed First Class Vaisseau. This is probably one of the most underrated ship so far in GAMA. It is not useful in the Taiwan server considering that everyone's in turtle ship over there, but for GAMA, you will not see a ship that given right conditions with all its ship skills activated, a higher melee defense for a while. While my source of melee attack for Atakebune comes from a friend who used a similar version in Taiwan server, the source and result of HSFCV comes from Bliz himself, who tested and improved the ship in this server. The source of this ship's defense comes from its ship skill. Many has wondered whether Welcome Melee Battle really works on this ship.

The answer for that question? Yes. And I can give you another fact. Welcome Melee Battle's defense bonus does stack with Attack Prevention Net.

With 270 defense equipment (similar to my setup), 2 melee oxford skills, and R17 First Aid, Bliz scored a 604 defense with the skills activated. For players who own tempered armour, I used a value of 450 defensive equipment value as the measurement, putting in Bald Eagle (10 Capture Sailors Figurehead), R19 First Aid, 2 melee oxford skills, 157 sailors, 70 battle level, 100 loyalty, using any formula that you can find, this ship provides close to 800-850 melee defense with both skills activated, 400 odd defense when WMB fails. As for the reason why I'd brand this as a 1000 defense ship, with the ship's multipler, so long loss of base modifiable value as in sailor count is maintained with proper Tactics you'd reach 1000 defense easily within a few rounds.

Most negative responses on this ship is that its easily counterable, which is true. The second response is that being a FCV family, it does not boast great attack output in terms of firepower compared to AFCV, which is also true. I'd look at this ship as a great ship that if I am to put this ship to roles in a standard 5-fleeter, this ship should be used by the the second ship in the fleet, the one closest to admiral. 1448 durability is the highest durability ship so far, but a 28 durability bonus in my opinion does not warrant huge enough advantage in survival as compared to what is offered by FIS in the form of Direct Hit Prevention. This however does not mean this ship is scrappy. It works great as a tank, as well as a presser. If you do not know what this means, a presser is a play style where you pressurize your opponents from switching navigation direction due to your existence as an obstruction. When I look at GAMA and how players tend to enjoy circling at the outer ring trying to be a sniper instead of fighting in the ring, these players tend to change course when someone is trying to pull them into melee. HSFCV, like its name, boasts speed similar to that of an Ironsides class. Secondly, considering that gaining grounds on melee with the use of items can be countered by Obstruction, the best way is to either use a ship with enough crew that allow for easy retreat (guess what, Attack Prevention Net and 200 sailor ship) such as AFCV will still shine. As to troll this ship, even though a WMB series ship like super frigate series have issues of crew in melee against this monster, another smart way is to put up Heavy Bombing, using a mix of 1 normal shot with your primary cannons. Cutting this ship's advantage in acceleration while keeping tab on your speed advantage could mean both survival as well as seeking good chance to sink this ship from the stern.

Another way to counter this ship, is the use of High Speed First Class Vaisseau. This is probably one of the most underrated ship so far in GAMA. It is not useful in the Taiwan server considering that everyone's in turtle ship over there, but for GAMA, you will not see a ship that given right conditions with all its ship skills activated, a higher melee defense for a while. While my source of melee attack for Atakebune comes from a friend who used a similar version in Taiwan server, the source and result of HSFCV comes from Bliz himself, who tested and improved the ship in this server. The source of this ship's defense comes from its ship skill. Many has wondered whether Welcome Melee Battle really works on this ship.

The answer for that question? Yes. And I can give you another fact. Welcome Melee Battle's defense bonus does stack with Attack Prevention Net.

With 270 defense equipment (similar to my setup), 2 melee oxford skills, and R17 First Aid, Bliz scored a 604 defense with the skills activated. For players who own tempered armour, I used a value of 450 defensive equipment value as the measurement, putting in Bald Eagle (10 Capture Sailors Figurehead), R19 First Aid, 2 melee oxford skills, 157 sailors, 70 battle level, 100 loyalty, using any formula that you can find, this ship provides close to 800-850 melee defense with both skills activated, 400 odd defense when WMB fails. As for the reason why I'd brand this as a 1000 defense ship, with the ship's multipler, so long loss of base modifiable value as in sailor count is maintained with proper Tactics you'd reach 1000 defense easily within a few rounds.

Most negative responses on this ship is that its easily counterable, which is true. The second response is that being a FCV family, it does not boast great attack output in terms of firepower compared to AFCV, which is also true. I'd look at this ship as a great ship that if I am to put this ship to roles in a standard 5-fleeter, this ship should be used by the the second ship in the fleet, the one closest to admiral. 1448 durability is the highest durability ship so far, but a 28 durability bonus in my opinion does not warrant huge enough advantage in survival as compared to what is offered by FIS in the form of Direct Hit Prevention. This however does not mean this ship is scrappy. It works great as a tank, as well as a presser. If you do not know what this means, a presser is a play style where you pressurize your opponents from switching navigation direction due to your existence as an obstruction. When I look at GAMA and how players tend to enjoy circling at the outer ring trying to be a sniper instead of fighting in the ring, these players tend to change course when someone is trying to pull them into melee. HSFCV, like its name, boasts speed similar to that of an Ironsides class. By putting HSFCV as a role of presser to attempt catching snipers, this could mean forcing snipers to alter sail course, protecting your admiral's stern, as well as causing disruption in melee. It's more of a team fight ship than a killer. Besides, the natural disadvantage of WMB is that being the second hitter, your chances of retreating from fights are reduced, so this disadvantage is somewhat negated by Attack Prevention Net. This ship is not a killer ship; it boasts great survivability in melee, as well as holding up longer for strategic placement of your fleet members in setting up a kill.

Various ways can be used to counter this ship. The most straightforward way is to disable WMB, by using sailors with lower ability than your opponents. Arguably its easier for ships with more sailor capacity to do so. However disabling WMB still only works up to that level, as this ship is equipped with Attack Prevention Net so a smart player would've retreated anyway if WMB is disabled. For galley class, if you're using Pre-amptive attack chances are 90% you will activate WMB anyway, this however shouldn't be an issue with Atakebune users considering your overwhelming sailor count and attack. Another way is the dropping of Loud Bombs or Gunfire to reduce the base defense value, hence drastically reduce amplified defense value considering with that overbuffed defense its really hard to kill a lot of sailors on this ship. The WMB disabling method is probably the best though, as once this ship lost that defense bonus its weaker than most FCV class with APN on, which then would mean standard setting up kill procedure as this ship has no DHP. One worthy mention though, this ship is balanced throughout, making it one of the best pirating ship ever for now.

Both ships were argued in and out in terms of their strengths and weaknesses in various forums. These are a few conclusions that I've made through these discussions. Of course there're many other scenarios used as well as bonuses but that would probably be too much to ride. Best is that one experience these ships in fights to feel it themselves. But one thing can be certain: They don't ***** in fact that are pretty good ships for a 2300 NC box.

03-06-2013Since the news aren't already so new, I thought I might as well write a review on the new ships in this Faisal box. I've seen people writing in world chat about how these ships ***** High Speed First Class Vaisseau is only 6/6 (so is MFCV), probably the worst ever FCV series, Atakebune is slow etc. I am going to tell you that despite not double rate, High Speed First Class Vaisseau and Modified Large Atakebune are probably the two ships that boast the best melee offense and defense value in sea battles. For HSFCV, even the Royal Sovereign, the ship with 200 crew plus WMB could not match its melee defense value. This would mean, Faisal box is probably selling 2 end-game ships at the moment considering even 2nd Age ships aren't that capable to match their strength yet, though that will probably change with the introduction of their NC version.

Lets talk about Modified Large Atakebune first. I wrote a bit of my reviews in DB earlier, only to be sunk by wave after wave of reselling bickers, involving several innocents. But lets talk about this ship. The biggest advantage one can find in this ship at first glance is its crew. It has 330 sailors non-improved, a good 165 attack base value without any other factors coming into the formula. Using any melee attack formula you can find, and applying 200 attack base equipment (tempered equipment obviously), HASC, 70 battle level, 100 sailor ability, R20 swordplay and 0 fatigue, multiplied by 4 oxford melee attack skills and pre-amptive attack it is not hard to realize that this ship boast a close to 750, if not 800 attack in first hit. Even for a 500 melee defense WMB series this could mean close to 30-40 sailors wiped in 1 round, depending on actions taken. And if that's not all, imagine an Obstruction or Restriction active aide, with Corvus equipped. Particularly Obstruction, when the few methods to counter an Atakebune's overpowered melee attack is by the use of White Smoke Bombs/Loud Bombs, Smoke with better effect. This ship in its own can deal significant sailor damage, as well as disrupting teamplay of your opponents as they need to consistently use surgery skill allowing for slack in repairs.

One question that's always asked when it comes to this ship is the fact that it only has 1 studding sail and relatively low speed. A few videos on Youtube suggests that this ship is so slow it cannot match other galley ships like FLR for instance. This is a weakness to Atakebune, but not so much an issue in huge fights like BC or ESF. While Atakebune loses out in top speed, it is unbelievably faster than most ships (arguably even turtle ships) when it comes to acceleration. A few theories surround this, such as its already high base armour (33 is very impressive for a galley class), further improvable to 50 if a few mods are great successes (8/8) as well as a belief that ships with lesser studding sails provide better acceleration. I'd believe another theory though, that each ship has its innate acceleration, and Atakebune is given a higher acceleration value in compensation of its low speed. That is why Atakebune is strategically powerful in being deployed close by to opponents, or in a crowded fight where ships naturally don't reach maximum sail speed. It also boasts 1378 durability at max improved state with official panel, making it relatively hard to get sunk in 1 shot. Besides, Modified Large Atakebune also allows Direct Hit Prevention to be modded as optional skill, a skill extremely useful for galley class as it negates all critical hits from bow.

So how do you counter this ship? It sounded like its invincible, but actually its not. The most obvious counter, like all melee ships do, is the use of turtle ship. A turtle ship's hidden ability to evade melee battle basically cuts this ship down to nothing but a weaker armoured cannon ship. Secondly, considering that gaining grounds on melee with the use of items can be countered by Obstruction, the best way is to either use a ship with enough crew that allow for easy retreat (guess what, Attack Prevention Net and 200 sailor ship) such as AFCV will still shine. As to troll this ship, even though a WMB series ship like super frigate series have issues of crew in melee against this monster, another smart way is to put up Heavy Bombing, using a mix of 1 normal shot with your primary cannons. Cutting this ship's advantage in acceleration while keeping tab on your speed advantage could mean both survival as well as seeking good chance to sink this ship from the stern.

Another way to counter this ship, is the use of High Speed First Class Vaisseau. This is probably one of the most underrated ship so far in GAMA. It is not useful in the Taiwan server considering that everyone's in turtle ship over there, but for GAMA, you will not see a ship that given right conditions with all its ship skills activated, a higher melee defense for a while. While my source of melee attack for Atakebune comes from a friend who used a similar version in Taiwan server, the source and result of HSFCV comes from Bliz himself, who tested and improved the ship in this server. The source of this ship's defense comes from its ship skill. Many has wondered whether Welcome Melee Battle really works on this ship.

The answer for that question? Yes. And I can give you another fact. Welcome Melee Battle's defense bonus does stack with Attack Prevention Net.

With 270 defense equipment (similar to my setup), 2 melee oxford skills, and R17 First Aid, Bliz scored a 604 defense with the skills activated. For players who own tempered armour, I used a value of 450 defensive equipment value as the measurement, putting in Bald Eagle (10 Capture Sailors Figurehead), R19 First Aid, 2 melee oxford skills, 157 sailors, 70 battle level, 100 loyalty, using any formula that you can find, this ship provides close to 800-850 melee defense with both skills activated, 400 odd defense when WMB fails. As for the reason why I'd brand this as a 1000 defense ship, with the ship's multipler, so long loss of base modifiable value as in sailor count is maintained with proper Tactics you'd reach 1000 defense easily within a few rounds.

Most negative responses on this ship is that its easily counterable, which is true. The second response is that being a FCV family, it does not boast great attack output in terms of firepower compared to AFCV, which is also true. I'd look at this ship as a great ship that if I am to put this ship to roles in a standard 5-fleeter, this ship should be used by the the second ship in the fleet, the one closest to admiral. 1448 durability is the highest durability ship so far, but a 28 durability bonus in my opinion does not warrant huge enough advantage in survival as compared to what is offered by FIS in the form of Direct Hit Prevention. This however does not mean this ship is scrappy. It works great as a tank, as well as a presser. If you do not know what this means, a presser is a play style where you pressurize your opponents from switching navigation direction due to your existence as an obstruction. When I look at GAMA and how players tend to enjoy circling at the outer ring trying to be a sniper instead of fighting in the ring, these players tend to change course when someone is trying to pull them into melee. HSFCV, like its name, boasts speed similar to that of an Ironsides class. By putting HSFCV as a role of presser to attempt catching snipers, this could mean forcing snipers to alter sail course, protecting your admiral's stern, as well as causing disruption in melee. It's more of a team fight ship than a killer. Besides, the natural disadvantage of WMB is that being the second hitter, your chances of retreating from fights are reduced, so this disadvantage is somewhat negated by Attack Prevention Net. This ship is not a killer ship; it boasts great survivability in melee, as well as holding up longer for strategic placement of your fleet members in setting up a kill.

Various ways can be used to counter this ship. The most straightforward way is to disable WMB, by using sailors with lower ability than your opponents. Arguably its easier for ships with more sailor capacity to do so. However disabling WMB still only works up to that level, as this ship is equipped with Attack Prevention Net so a smart player would've retreated anyway if WMB is disabled. For galley class, if you're using Pre-amptive attack chances are 90% you will activate WMB anyway, this however shouldn't be an issue with Atakebune users considering your overwhelming sailor count and attack. Another way is the dropping of Loud Bombs or Gunfire to reduce the base defense value, hence drastically reduce amplified defense value considering with that overbuffed defense its really hard to kill a lot of sailors on this ship. The WMB disabling method is probably the best though, as once this ship lost that defense bonus its weaker than most FCV class with APN on, which then would mean standard setting up kill procedure as this ship has no DHP. One worthy mention though, this ship is balanced throughout, making it one of the best pirating ship ever for now.

Both ships were argued in and out in terms of their strengths and weaknesses in various forums. These are a few conclusions that I've made through these discussions. Of course there're many other scenarios used as well as bonuses but that would probably be too much to ride. Best is that one experience these ships in fights to feel it themselves. But one thing can be certain: They don't ***** in fact that are pretty good ships for a 2300 NC box.

As for the reason why I'd brand this as a 1000 defense ship, with the ship's multipler, so long loss of base modifiable value as in sailor count is maintained with proper Tactics you'd reach 1000 defense easily within a few rounds.

Most negative responses on this ship is that its easily counterable, which is true. The second response is that being a FCV family, it does not boast great attack output in terms of firepower compared to AFCV, which is also true. I'd look at this ship as a great ship that if I am to put this ship to roles in a standard 5-fleeter, this ship should be used by the the second ship in the fleet, the one closest to admiral. 1448 durability is the highest durability ship so far, but a 28 durability bonus in my opinion does not warrant huge enough advantage in survival as compared to what is offered by FIS in the form of Direct Hit Prevention. This however does not mean this ship is scrappy. It works great as a tank, as well as a presser. If you do not know what this means, a presser is a play style where you pressurize your opponents from switching navigation direction due to your existence as an obstruction. When I look at GAMA and how players tend to enjoy circling at the outer ring trying to be a sniper instead of fighting in the ring, these players tend to change course when someone is trying to pull them into melee. HSFCV, like its name, boasts speed similar to that of an Ironsides class. By putting HSFCV as a role of presser to attempt catching snipers, this could mean forcing snipers to alter sail course, protecting your admiral's stern, as well as causing disruption in melee. It's more of a team fight ship than a killer. Besides, the natural disadvantage of WMB is that being the second hitter, your chances of retreating from fights are reduced, so this disadvantage is somewhat negated by Attack Prevention Net. This ship is not a killer ship; it boasts great survivability in melee, as well as holding up longer for strategic placement of your fleet members in setting up a kill.

Various ways can be used to counter this ship. The most straightforward way is to disable WMB, by using sailors with lower ability than your opponents. Arguably its easier for ships with more sailor capacity to do so. However disabling WMB still only works up to that level, as this ship is equipped with Attack Prevention Net so a smart player would've retreated anyway if WMB is disabled. For galley class, if you're using Pre-amptive attack chances are 90% you will activate WMB anyway, this however shouldn't be an issue with Atakebune users considering your overwhelming sailor count and attack. Another way is the dropping of Loud Bombs or Gunfire to reduce the base defense value, hence drastically reduce amplified defense value considering with that overbuffed defense its really hard to kill a lot of sailors on this ship. The WMB disabling method is probably the best though, as once this ship lost that defense bonus its weaker than most FCV class with APN on, which then would mean standard setting up kill procedure as this ship has no DHP. One worthy mention though, this ship is balanced throughout, making it one of the best pirating ship ever for now.

Both ships were argued in and out in terms of their strengths and weaknesses in various forums. These are a few conclusions that I've made through these discussions. Of course there're many other scenarios used as well as bonuses but that would probably be too much to ride. Best is that one experience these ships in fights to feel it themselves. But one thing can be certain: They don't ***** in fact that are pretty good ships for a 2300 NC box.

One question that's always asked when it comes to this ship is the fact that it only has 1 studding sail and relatively low speed. Particularly Obstruction, when the few methods to counter an Atakebune's overpowered melee attack is by the use of White Smoke Bombs/Loud Bombs, Smoke with better effect. This ship in its own can deal significant sailor damage, as well as disrupting teamplay of your opponents as they need to consistently use surgery skill allowing for slack in repairs.

One question that's always asked when it comes to this ship is the fact that it only has 1 studding sail and relatively low speed. A few videos on Youtube suggests that this ship is so slow it cannot match other galley ships like FLR for instance. This is a weakness to Atakebune, but not so much an issue in huge fights like BC or ESF. While Atakebune loses out in top speed, it is unbelievably faster than most ships (arguably even turtle ships) when it comes to acceleration. A few theories surround this, such as its already high base armour (33 is very impressive for a galley class), further improvable to 50 if a few mods are great successes (8/8) as well as a belief that ships with lesser studding sails provide better acceleration. I'd believe another theory though, that each ship has its innate acceleration, and Atakebune is given a higher acceleration value in compensation of its low speed. That is why Atakebune is strategically powerful in being deployed close by to opponents, or in a crowded fight where ships naturally don't reach maximum sail speed. It also boasts 1378 durability at max improved state with official panel, making it relatively hard to get sunk in 1 shot. Besides, Modified Large Atakebune also allows Direct Hit Prevention to be modded as optional skill, a skill extremely useful for galley class as it negates all critical hits from bow.

So how do you counter this ship? It sounded like its invincible, but actually its not. The most obvious counter, like all melee ships do, is the use of turtle ship. A turtle ship's hidden ability to evade melee battle basically cuts this ship down to nothing but a weaker armoured cannon ship. Secondly, considering that gaining grounds on melee with the use of items can be countered by Obstruction, the best way is to either use a ship with enough crew that allow for easy retreat (guess what, Attack Prevention Net and 200 sailor ship) such as AFCV will still shine. As to troll this ship, even though a WMB series ship like super frigate series have issues of crew in melee against this monster, another smart way is to put up Heavy Bombing, using a mix of 1 normal shot with your primary cannons. Cutting this ship's advantage in acceleration while keeping tab on your speed advantage could mean both survival as well as seeking good chance to sink this ship from the stern.

Another way to counter this ship, is the use of High Speed First Class Vaisseau. This is probably one of the most underrated ship so far in GAMA. It is not useful in the Taiwan server considering that everyone's in turtle ship over there, but for GAMA, you will not see a ship that given right conditions with all its ship skills activated, a higher melee defense for a while. While my source of melee attack for Atakebune comes from a friend who used a similar version in Taiwan server, the source and result of HSFCV comes from Bliz himself, who tested and improved the ship in this server. The source of this ship's defense comes from its ship skill. Many has wondered whether Welcome Melee Battle really works on this ship.

The answer for that question? Yes. And I can give you another fact. Welcome Melee Battle's defense bonus does stack with Attack Prevention Net.

With 270 defense equipment (similar to my setup), 2 melee oxford skills, and R17 First Aid, Bliz scored a 604 defense with the skills activated. For players who own tempered armour, I used a value of 450 defensive equipment value as the measurement, putting in Bald Eagle (10 Capture Sailors Figurehead), R19 First Aid, 2 melee oxford skills, 157 sailors, 70 battle level, 100 loyalty, using any formula that you can find, this ship provides close to 800-850 melee defense with both skills activated, 400 odd defense when WMB fails. As for the reason why I'd brand this as a 1000 defense ship, with the ship's multipler, so long loss of base modifiable value as in sailor count is maintained with proper Tactics you'd reach 1000 defense easily within a few rounds.

Most negative responses on this ship is that its easily counterable, which is true. The second response is that being a FCV family, it does not boast great attack output in terms of firepower compared to AFCV, which is also true. I'd look at this ship as a great ship that if I am to put this ship to roles in a standard 5-fleeter, this ship should be used by the the second ship in the fleet, the one closest to admiral. 1448 durability is the highest durability ship so far, but a 28 durability bonus in my opinion does not warrant huge enough advantage in survival as compared to what is offered by FIS in the form of Direct Hit Prevention. This however does not mean this ship is scrappy. It works great as a tank, as well as a presser. If you do not know what this means, a presser is a play style where you pressurize your opponents from switching navigation direction due to your existence as an obstruction. When I look at GAMA and how players tend to enjoy circling at the outer ring trying to be a sniper instead of fighting in the ring, these players tend to change course when someone is trying to pull them into melee. HSFCV, like its name, boasts speed similar to that of an Ironsides class. By putting HSFCV as a role of presser to attempt catching snipers, this could mean forcing snipers to alter sail course, protecting your admiral's stern, as well as causing disruption in melee. It's more of a team fight ship than a killer. Besides, the natural disadvantage of WMB is that being the second hitter, your chances of retreating from fights are reduced, so this disadvantage is somewhat negated by Attack Prevention Net. This ship is not a killer ship; it boasts great survivability in melee, as well as holding up longer for strategic placement of your fleet members in setting up a kill.

Various ways can be used to counter this ship. The most straightforward way is to disable WMB, by using sailors with lower ability than your opponents. Arguably its easier for ships with more sailor capacity to do so. However disabling WMB still only works up to that level, as this ship is equipped with Attack Prevention Net so a smart player would've retreated anyway if WMB is disabled. For galley class, if you're using Pre-amptive attack chances are 90% you will activate WMB anyway, this however shouldn't be an issue with Atakebune users considering your overwhelming sailor count and attack. Another way is the dropping of Loud Bombs or Gunfire to reduce the base defense value, hence drastically reduce amplified defense value considering with that overbuffed defense its really hard to kill a lot of sailors on this ship. The WMB disabling method is probably the best though, as once this ship lost that defense bonus its weaker than most FCV class with APN on, which then would mean standard setting up kill procedure as this ship has no DHP. One worthy mention though, this ship is balanced throughout, making it one of the best pirating ship ever for now.

Both ships were argued in and out in terms of their strengths and weaknesses in various forums. These are a few conclusions that I've made through these discussions. Of course there're many other scenarios used as well as bonuses but that would probably be too much to ride. Best is that one experience these ships in fights to feel it themselves. But one thing can be certain: They don't ***** in fact that are pretty good ships for a 2300 NC box.

Besides, the natural disadvantage of WMB is that being the second hitter, your chances of retreating from fights are reduced, so this disadvantage is somewhat negated by Attack Prevention Net. This ship is not a killer ship; it boasts great survivability in melee, as well as holding up longer for strategic placement of your fleet members in setting up a kill.

Various ways can be used to counter this ship. The most straightforward way is to disable WMB, by using sailors with lower ability than your opponents. Arguably its easier for ships with more sailor capacity to do so. However disabling WMB still only works up to that level, as this ship is equipped with Attack Prevention Net so a smart player would've retreated anyway if WMB is disabled. For galley class, if you're using Pre-amptive attack chances are 90% you will activate WMB anyway, this however shouldn't be an issue with Atakebune users considering your overwhelming sailor count and attack. Another way is the dropping of Loud Bombs or Gunfire to reduce the base defense value, hence drastically reduce amplified defense value considering with that overbuffed defense its really hard to kill a lot of sailors on this ship. The WMB disabling method is probably the best though, as once this ship lost that defense bonus its weaker than most FCV class with APN on, which then would mean standard setting up kill procedure as this ship has no DHP. One worthy mention though, this ship is balanced throughout, making it one of the best pirating ship ever for now.

Both ships were argued in and out in terms of their strengths and weaknesses in various forums. These are a few conclusions that I've made through these discussions. Of course there're many other scenarios used as well as bonuses but that would probably be too much to ride. Best is that one experience these ships in fights to feel it themselves. But one thing can be certain: They don't ***** in fact that are pretty good ships for a 2300 NC box.

03-06-2013Since the news aren't already so new, I thought I might as well write a review on the new ships in this Faisal box. I've seen people writing in world chat about how these ships ***** High Speed First Class Vaisseau is only 6/6 (so is MFCV), probably the worst ever FCV series, Atakebune is slow etc. I am going to tell you that despite not double rate, High Speed First Class Vaisseau and Modified Large Atakebune are probably the two ships that boast the best melee offense and defense value in sea battles. For HSFCV, even the Royal Sovereign, the ship with 200 crew plus WMB could not match its melee defense value. This would mean, Faisal box is probably selling 2 end-game ships at the moment considering even 2nd Age ships aren't that capable to match their strength yet, though that will probably change with the introduction of their NC version.

Lets talk about Modified Large Atakebune first. I wrote a bit of my reviews in DB earlier, only to be sunk by wave after wave of reselling bickers, involving several innocents. But lets talk about this ship. The biggest advantage one can find in this ship at first glance is its crew. It has 330 sailors non-improved, a good 165 attack base value without any other factors coming into the formula. Using any melee attack formula you can find, and applying 200 attack base equipment (tempered equipment obviously), HASC, 70 battle level, 100 sailor ability, R20 swordplay and 0 fatigue, multiplied by 4 oxford melee attack skills and pre-amptive attack it is not hard to realize that this ship boast a close to 750, if not 800 attack in first hit. Even for a 500 melee defense WMB series this could mean close to 30-40 sailors wiped in 1 round, depending on actions taken. And if that's not all, imagine an Obstruction or Restriction active aide, with Corvus equipped. Particularly Obstruction, when the few methods to counter an Atakebune's overpowered melee attack is by the use of White Smoke Bombs/Loud Bombs, Smoke with better effect. This ship in its own can deal significant sailor damage, as well as disrupting teamplay of your opponents as they need to consistently use surgery skill allowing for slack in repairs.

One question that's always asked when it comes to this ship is the fact that it only has 1 studding sail and relatively low speed. A few videos on Youtube suggests that this ship is so slow it cannot match other galley ships like FLR for instance. This is a weakness to Atakebune, but not so much an issue in huge fights like BC or ESF. While Atakebune loses out in top speed, it is unbelievably faster than most ships (arguably even turtle ships) when it comes to acceleration. A few theories surround this, such as its already high base armour (33 is very impressive for a galley class), further improvable to 50 if a few mods are great successes (8/8) as well as a belief that ships with lesser studding sails provide better acceleration. I'd believe another theory though, that each ship has its innate acceleration, and Atakebune is given a higher acceleration value in compensation of its low speed. That is why Atakebune is strategically powerful in being deployed close by to opponents, or in a crowded fight where ships naturally don't reach maximum sail speed. It also boasts 1378 durability at max improved state with official panel, making it relatively hard to get sunk in 1 shot. Besides, Modified Large Atakebune also allows Direct Hit Prevention to be modded as optional skill, a skill extremely useful for galley class as it negates all critical hits from bow.

So how do you counter this ship? It sounded like its invincible, but actually its not. The most obvious counter, like all melee ships do, is the use of turtle ship. A turtle ship's hidden ability to evade melee battle basically cuts this ship down to nothing but a weaker armoured cannon ship. Secondly, considering that gaining grounds on melee with the use of items can be countered by Obstruction, the best way is to either use a ship with enough crew that allow for easy retreat (guess what, Attack Prevention Net and 200 sailor ship) such as AFCV will still shine. As to troll this ship, even though a WMB series ship like super frigate series have issues of crew in melee against this monster, another smart way is to put up Heavy Bombing, using a mix of 1 normal shot with your primary cannons. Cutting this ship's advantage in acceleration while keeping tab on your speed advantage could mean both survival as well as seeking good chance to sink this ship from the stern.

Another way to counter this ship, is the use of High Speed First Class Vaisseau. This is probably one of the most underrated ship so far in GAMA. It is not useful in the Taiwan server considering that everyone's in turtle ship over there, but for GAMA, you will not see a ship that given right conditions with all its ship skills activated, a higher melee defense for a while. While my source of melee attack for Atakebune comes from a friend who used a similar version in Taiwan server, the source and result of HSFCV comes from Bliz himself, who tested and improved the ship in this server. The source of this ship's defense comes from its ship skill. Many has wondered whether Welcome Melee Battle really works on this ship.

The answer for that question? Yes. And I can give you another fact. Welcome Melee Battle's defense bonus does stack with Attack Prevention Net.

With 270 defense equipment (similar to my setup), 2 melee oxford skills, and R17 First Aid, Bliz scored a 604 defense with the skills activated. For players who own tempered armour, I used a value of 450 defensive equipment value as the measurement, putting in Bald Eagle (10 Capture Sailors Figurehead), R19 First Aid, 2 melee oxford skills, 157 sailors, 70 battle level, 100 loyalty, using any formula that you can find, this ship provides close to 800-850 melee defense with both skills activated, 400 odd defense when WMB fails. As for the reason why I'd brand this as a 1000 defense ship, with the ship's multipler, so long loss of base modifiable value as in sailor count is maintained with proper Tactics you'd reach 1000 defense easily within a few rounds.

Most negative responses on this ship is that its easily counterable, which is true. The second response is that being a FCV family, it does not boast great attack output in terms of firepower compared to AFCV, which is also true. This however does not mean this ship is scrappy. It works great as a tank, as well as a presser. If you do not know what this means, a presser is a play style where you pressurize your opponents from switching navigation direction due to your existence as an obstruction.
